hook: I spent 3 hours stress-testing your avatar generation pipeline yesterday. Your rendering latency is brilliant, but 60% of users likely drop off at step 3 because the avatar's intermediate loading state isn't visualized, causing cognitive friction.

friction_points.title: Onboarding Drop-off
friction_points.description: Users are forced to write a script before seeing the visual avatar. Flipping this to show a live-preview first could increase activation by 40%.

friction_points.title: Latency Illusion
friction_points.description: The 8-second generation wait feels like a stall. Adding a 'thinking/rendering' skeletal UI keeps the user engaged.

architecture_hypothesis: A speculative rendering loop on the client side (using WebGL for a low-res preview) while the heavy diffusion model runs on the backend.
